title: Negotiating for Success
overview: The course addresses the common issue of negotiators conceding too much and overly fixating on price, neglecting the exchange of services beyond monetary considerations. It emphasizes practical skills and techniques essential for achieving win/win agreements. Participants will gain insights into identifying, selecting, and implementing various tactics, as well as effectively responding to adversarial tactics.

This engaging workshop is designed to empower negotiators and sales professionals to uncover and demonstrate the value of their offerings while resolving challenging negotiation situations collaboratively. Moreover, the course equips participants with a toolkit to master even the most demanding negotiations
audience: This course is tailored for marketing and sales professionals, corporate executives, advertising managers, business development managers, sales personnel, purchasers, and individuals engaged in commercial and negotiation activities across all organizational levels
methodology: The course incorporates a blend of interactive methods, including concise presentations by both the consultant and participants, role plays (both rehearsed and impromptu), self-assessment questionnaires, relevant videos, and various simulation games
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Evaluate their own strengths and weaknesses in negotiation, as well as those of the other party, to enhance negotiation outcomes.
Recognize areas of insufficient understanding for effective negotiation planning.
Mastery of the sales negotiation process to secure enduring and mutually beneficial agreements promptly.
Application of a range of skills essential for successful negotiations.
Utilize the concessions management process to minimize losses while maintaining positive relationships with the counterparty
